description: Add several creators as manual matches to a campaign in one call. Idempotent on (campaign, profileId). Stores the platform, handle, name, picture, and follower count of each catalog profile, and keeps only profileId and fitScore from the input. A profileId outside the catalog fails the call with a tool error naming it, and nothing is added. Returns added, the count of new matches, and present, the count already on the campaign, with addedCreators and presentCreators, the same counts per person, so a person with two matched profiles counts once. A campaign outside the caller's organization returns not_found. While a send request is open, once the campaign is sent, or while it is archived, it returns a tool error naming the reason. Needs a credential.

creators.description: The creators to add to the campaign, as search_creators or get_list returns them

fitScore.description: Fit score from search_creators, 0 to 1, or null when unknown

followerCount.description: Follower count at snapshot time, at least 1000

platform.description: ig for Instagram or tt for TikTok

profileImageUrl.description: Portrait URL from search_creators, or null

username.description: Creator handle from search_creators, or null

name: add_campaign_matches
title: Add campaign matches
